articles.title: Ford Worker Who Heckled Trump Draws Support of Auto Union
articles.mainIdea: Ford Worker Who Heckled Trump Draws Support of Auto Union
articles.summary: Bloomberg: Ford Worker Who Heckled Trump Draws Support of Auto Union. “The autoworker at the Dearborn Truck Plant is a proud member of a strong and fighting union—the UAW,” Laura Dickerson, the UAW vice president over the union’s Ford Department, said in a statement Wednesday. The worker, TJ Sabula, told the Washington Post he had “definitely no regrets” about shouting at Trump as the president toured Ford’s F-150 pickup truck factory in Dearborn, Michigan, on Tuesday.

articles.title: Ford Suspends Factory Worker for Heckling Trump
articles.mainIdea: Ford Suspends Factory Worker for Heckling Trump
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Ford Suspends Factory Worker for Heckling Trump. Ford Motor has suspended a worker who heckled President Trump during a tour of a Michigan truck factory on Tuesday. T.J. Sabula shouted out “pedophile protector” as Trump walked past. Trump visited the plant to tout efforts to bolster U.S. auto manufacturing.
